text:
Mona: Heads-up: ran the microbatch coord experiment this morning. Eviction noise spiked; want to align signals. TL;DR: eviction events are racing with prefetch warmup and causing suboptimal KV hits.

Sahil: Can you paste the graphs? which metric spiked?

Mona: CPU and kv_warm_hit_rate drop right after eviction pulses. See quick snippet: https://internal.charts/run/evict-2026-03-23 (will add dashboard link in RFC)

Elaine: We saw similar on canary—short-lived evictions causing re-warm loops. Proposal: aggregate eviction signals into a 50ms debounce + heartbeat smoothing in scheduler.

Tim: 50ms debounce feels long for 50ms SLOs. Maybe make it adaptive: debounce = min(50ms, p95_latency/4) ?

Mona: Good point. Adaptive would avoid harming tiny-window fastpath. Implementation idea: windowed counter + exponential decay, not hard debounce.

Devon: How do we surface this across components? current eviction signal is just a boolean from node-agent. Maybe add metadata: {source, severity, lease_id, seq} — low-overhead header.

Mona: Exactly. Thinking of header `X-Evict-Sigil: seq=1234;src=prefetch;sev=soft;grace_ms=80` — scheduler can decide to ignore soft unless persistent.

Sahil: We'll need a contract: what 'soft' means. It should be <= 1 batch worth of tokens. Hard means immediate eviction and invalidate KV lines.

Elaine: Also add a 'grace' hint: grace_ms=xxx so receivers pick backoff. Otherwise we'll thrash.

Mona: Experiment results: with 100ms decay we reduced thrashed warmups by ~22% and tail latency improved 8% for 1-token requests. But throughput dropped 3% on high concurrency.

Tim: 3% throughput loss might be acceptable if tails improve. Need cost/benefit per tenant. Can we make it per-tenant policy?

Devon: Yes, policy flag at admission: `tenant.eviction_sensitivity = low|normal|high`. Default normal. Add rollout via feature flag.

Mona: Plan: implement header, adaptive decay, feature flag. Start with canary (2 nodes), collect kv_hit, latency_p95, throughput. Rollout timeline: canary today, +4days expanded.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: batcher-coord:v2 -> canary(2).

Sahil: :thumbsup: I'll take the header patch + tests. Elaine, can you update the telemetry dash to include `evict_signal_seq` and `evict_soft_rate`?

Elaine: On it. Will add dash and alert if soft_rate > 20% and p95 increases >5%.

Tim: One more: ensure that prefetch warmup uses seq to ignore repeated soft evicts within same seq window.

Mona: Agree. I'll write a short RFC addendum the next hour with the config knobs and expected metrics. Quick ask: @Devon can you own rollout checklist?

Devon: Yep, will own the checklist and rollback criteria.
